verdict.rationale: Mastra is a code-first TypeScript framework that runs headlessly on Node.js, Bun, Deno or Cloudflare and deploys as a server to any Node-compatible environment. For unattended automation it documents cron-scheduled workflows and agents, background tasks, and programmatic result objects that report status and errors. Scorers act as automated tests of agent outputs, and the Studio UI is optional. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., running evals or workflows in GitHub Actions), a documented headless CLI run mode, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
